item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zV8sajJE0lE

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭秘提前洩漏的 NVIDIA DLSS 5 技術在二次元與 3A 大作中的真實重構表現。
  • 深入剖析 AI 渲染技術在缺乏引擎底層數據時出現「畫風崩壞」與「油膩感」的核心原因。
  • 展望 DLSS 5 正式版在遊戲原生適配後的發展潛力，以及其對畫質與操作延遲帶來的深遠影響。

摘要

爭議中的 DLSS 5：技術洩漏引發的實測熱潮

作者指出，NVIDIA 的 DLSS 5 技術先前曾因展示畫面過於老化且充滿 AI 生成痕跡而遭到網友嘲諷。然而，隨著近期遊戲檔案意外洩漏，駭客將這項技術提取並公布教學，引發玩家在各類遊戲中展開大規模實測。作者強調，這項技術並非僅僅調節銳利度或飽和度，而是以近乎「重構」的方式徹底翻新了角色的皮膚材質與光影細節，讓舊遊戲展現出截然不同的全新品質，有力地反駁了外界對其效果的質疑。

風格適配度差異：二次元與寫實風格的兩極反應

在不同遊戲的測試中，作者觀察到 DLSS 5 的表現呈現兩極分化。例如在《黑暗靈魂：重製版》中，原本油膩模糊的貼圖被重構成細節豐富的盔甲質感；但在動漫風格作品中，效果卻大相逕庭。《原神》角色雖增加了立體感卻伴隨濃厚的 AI 塑料感，《終末地》的膚色渲染顯得扁平廉價；而《鳴潮》與《絕區零》的渲染風格則極為契合，連足部泛紅等微小細節都能細膩呈現。然而，作者也提醒，過度處理的場景依然會帶來令人不適的油膩廉價感。

技術瓶頸與未來展望：從「盲猜」到官方原生整合

針對在《垂死之光 2》等作品中發生的臉部識別失敗與嚴重穿幫現象，作者解釋道，目前外洩的版本僅相當於一個無法讀取引擎底層數據的「外置大腦」，只能憑空盲猜材質與光源。此外，該版本提取自運動競技遊戲，對複雜的 PBR 混合渲染管線適配不良。作者最後總結，未來若遊戲開發商能獲得官方支持並進行專屬微調，精準控制玻璃、金屬與臉部模型，畫面瑕疵將被徹底修正並帶來驚艷畫質，但隨之而來的輸入延遲仍是後續必須檢驗的核心問題。

================================================

Wait, is this even my waifu anymore? Jensen Huang is really riding the AI. wave now. Back in March, the actual. footage revealed for NVIDIA's new DLSS. 5 tech literally gave Geralt a new face. and made him look older. Since everyone. knew it was just AI-generated, netizens. were roasting it everywhere. Coincidentally, because the game files. for NBA 2K27 leaked recently, DLSS 5. got pulled out early too. Hackers put. the leaked files online with. instructions, which is why you’ve. been seeing videos everywhere these. past few days of users testing DLSS 5. on their own PCs across all sorts of. new, old, and anime-style games. It. really shut down all the criticism that.

DLSS 5 wasn't going to be any good—. it’s actually legit. Regardless of. the art style or face model issues, the. effect this thing has on games is. instantly noticeable. The game looks. like a completely different title after. turning it on. It doesn't just sharpen. the image or adjust saturation; it. genuinely overhauls the character skin. textures and lighting effects. It rolls. over everything like a beast, reshaping. everything on screen. Take the Dark. Souls remaster, for instance: the. original muddy, greasy textures become. incredibly crisp, and the armor. detailing is so good you just want to. reach out and touch it. Applying. Cyberpunk 2077's hyper-realistic.

lighting and textures to anime games. produces very different results. depending on the art style. It can even. give the ancient character models from. Genshin Impact a 3D effect. While it. looks good on someone like Eula, it's. just a bit over-the-top, with that AI. vibe practically jumping off the screen. . When used in*Endfield*, the effect. isn't as obvious; it just crushes the. orange skin tones into black, making it. look more like a low-budget mobile port. . The ones that benefit the most are*. Wuthering Waves*and*Zenless Zone Zero*. Their art styles and rendering methods. perfectly align with this new rendering. effect. The character presentation. feels great—especially the way it.

handles things like the subtle redness. on a character's feet. People used to. say characters were becoming too. generic, but look now—they've already. become AI-generated. Sure, the. characters look polished, but the. environments are still way. over-processed, with that cheap,. AI-style greasy look that's still a bit. hard on the eyes. DLSS 5 is amazing,. but the level of impact varies wildly. depending on the game. At the end of. the day, it all comes back to the. mismatch between the art style and the. face models. This isn't actually a. problem at all. You have to realize. that the "DLSS 5" being presented now. is a leaked version—not a formal.

release, not even a beta, but simply a. leaked build forced into various games. via mods. In other words, this current. DLSS 5 is an external brain; it works,. but it cannot currently read the game's. internal data, so the visual. information it receives is bound to be. inaccurate. If you are given a task. without the necessary data, it’s a. nightmare for any skilled engineer; it. has to guess entirely on its own where. to modify textures and lighting. For. instance, some players stuffed this. DLSS 5 into Dying Light 2 to test the. optimization on the heroine, Lawan. The. pores on her face were magnified and. reconstructed, but it still looked. unwatchable—it was so glitchy it.

could terrify you and even fail to. recognize human faces. How could it. possibly beautify someone so ugly? My " database" didn't teach me how to guess. that—just kidding, even if it guessed. right, it couldn't be saved. Plus, this. version was ripped from a competitive. game like NBA 2K24, so it has better. compatibility with stylized games. This. is why wrinkles on certain characters ' faces are deeply etched—more fitting. for a realistic art style—while in. Dying Light 2, the PBR and hybrid. rendering methods cause this leaked. DLSS 5 version to lack the reading and. processing power to handle it well. Conversely, in the near future, when. developers get their hands on the.

official DLSS 5 and integrate it into. their games, this "mismatched" DLSS. will be fine-tuned by production teams. specifically for their titles,. adjusting materials like glass and. metal reflections to match the game's. art style, and exerting precise control. over character faces and environment. art. Current issues like visual. glitches and facial deformations will. be easily resolved through the. developers' fine-tuning, providing. players with a more stable and unique. visual experience. The currently. underwhelming Dying Light 2 could very. well see stunning performance. improvements, and other titles will. surely be just as impressive. I’m.

just saying it's pretty good; it’s. just that...well, how's the latency?

=============

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zV8sajJE0lE

我觉得这效果还能再上一层楼
